name: galley-js-bun
description: Galley JavaScript bindings for Bun (galley-js-core over bun:ffi and bindings/c/galley.h)

scripts.prebuild: test -d ../core && ((command -v bun >/dev/null && bun --cwd ../core install --silent && bun --cwd ../core run build) || (command -v npm >/dev/null && npm --prefix ../core install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix ../core run build)) >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
scripts.prepare: test -d ../core && command -v npm >/dev/null && npm --prefix ../core run build >/dev/null 2>&1; tsc -p tsconfig.json --noCheck --types ""
